NaturalFormStep3Titles.PepDefinition: Panamanian law defines a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) as any national or foreign natural person who performs or has performed senior public functions or holds command and jurisdiction in a State, such as: Heads of State or government; high-profile politicians; senior government, judicial or military officials; senior executives of state-owned corporations; public officials holding elected office, among others who exercise decision-making authority in public entities. This also includes persons who perform or have been entrusted with important functions by an international organization, such as members of senior management, i.e., directors, deputy directors and members of the board of directors or equivalent functions. The concept of PEP must be extended to their close family members, understood as the spouse, parents, siblings and children of the PEP; and to their close associates, understood as persons known for their close relationship with the PEP, including those in a position to carry out financial, commercial or other transactions, whether local or international, on behalf of the PEP. The foregoing does not seek to cover persons of medium or lower rank than the categories indicated.

Policies.Title: Client Profile Form
Policies.LawHeading: IN COMPLIANCE WITH LAW 23 OF APRIL 27, 2015
Policies.LawText: This form and the requested documentation constitute the minimum legal due diligence requirements to profile you as a client and establish a business relationship with our company. Please note that during the process we may require additional information or documents beyond those presented here.
Policies.BeforeContinuingHeading: BEFORE CONTINUING, PLEASE NOTE THE FOLLOWING:
Policies.Point1: All information provided must be complete, truthful and verifiable.
Policies.Point2: We understand the importance of your privacy. Therefore, all personal information and documents you share with us will be handled under the highest standards of security and confidentiality.
Policies.Point3: You must present the original documents or corresponding certifications when the company requires them for validation purposes.

Titles.NoticeText: We understand the importance of your privacy. Therefore, all personal information and documents you share with us will be handled under the highest standards of security and confidentiality. Your data will be used exclusively for our due diligence process. As a Non-Financial Entity and in strict compliance with Law 23 of April 27, 2015, we guarantee the confidentiality and legal custody of your file, which will not be shared with third parties except upon express request by the supervisory authorities.

Titles.Declaration0: I declare voluntarily, free of any error, coercion or fraud, that all statements and answers I have made in this document are correct, truthful, complete, and I authorize URBAN DEVELOPMENT GROUP to verify all the detailed information. Furthermore, I undertake to inform URBAN DEVELOPMENT GROUP of any change or update to information that may affect the statements and answers noted in this form.
Titles.Declaration1: 1. I declare and certify that all information provided in this form is correct, true, and that the photocopies of passports, personal identification documents and other documents required in this application are genuine.
Titles.Declaration2: 2. The signer declares that they accept that our company may verify the information provided in this form at any time during the business relationship.
Titles.Declaration3: 3. The signer declares that, in accordance with the provisions of Law 23 of April 27, 2015 and its regulations issued by the Superintendency of Non-Financial Subjects, our company will request an update of this information annually for the duration of the business relationship.
Titles.Declaration4: 4. The signer declares that they have not been involved in or convicted, in Panama or in any other country, of crimes related to money laundering, drug trafficking, terrorism, fraud, or crimes of any nature.
Titles.Declaration5: 5. The signer declares that the services or goods requested from our company will only be used for lawful purposes.
Titles.Declaration6: 6. The signer declares that they acknowledge that this company is authorized to provide any information required by the Competent Authority.
Titles.Declaration7: 7. The signer declares that they release our company from any liability in the event that a competent Authority requires information related to the business relationship.
Titles.Declaration8: 8. The signer declares that they commit to informing our company of any change to the information provided in the form. URBAN DEVELOPMENT GROUP and its associated companies, hereinafter referred to as The Group, will handle the personal data you provide through the website, digital or physical forms, emails, mobile applications, or any other means by which you provide your data, as follows:
Titles.Declaration9: a) PURPOSE OF PERSONAL DATA PROCESSING: That my personal data will be processed by UDG for the following purposes: a) Sending information regarding our projects; processing my application to become a contractual counterparty ii) the negotiation process of the purchase agreement, iii) the execution and fulfillment of the contracts entered into, iv) fraud control and prevention, v) relationship with the CLIENT's bank vi) Carrying out the necessary actions for the development of THE CLIENT's corporate purpose and business activities, as well as for the conduct of its business, projects, campaigns, contact, information, sales, offers, and innovation initiatives, among others; (b) Carrying out the necessary actions to allow the complete execution of pre-contractual, contractual and post-contractual processes and duties with THE CLIENT, regarding any of the products, services or obligations offered by UDG, whether or not acquired, or regarding any underlying business relationship it has with UDG, including pre-legal and legal collections; (c) Conducting campaigns, contests, service quality evaluations, satisfaction surveys, communications and sending information to the data subject regarding events, products, services, offers, promotions, advertising, marketing, alliances, contests, service development, commercial matters and own content, from third parties and/or business partners, directly or through third parties; (d) Implementing relationship strategies with clients, suppliers, shareholders and other third parties with whom UDG has contractual or legal relationships; (e) Inviting to events, offering new products, and carrying out all activities associated with the business relationship or connection existing with UDG or that may come to exist; (f) Accessing, consulting, comparing, evaluating and reporting all information about THE CLIENT stored in the databases of any credit, financial, judicial background or security risk bureau, of a state or private, national or foreign nature, or any commercial or service database, that allows establishing in a comprehensive and complete historical manner the behavior as a debtor, user, client, guarantor, endorser, affiliate, beneficiary, subscriber, taxpayer, employee, contractor and/or as holder of financial, commercial or any other type of services, as well as national and international lists and databases, own and third-party, for the prevention of illicit activities such as money laundering and terrorist financing. All of the foregoing will be carried out for the benefit of itself or allied third parties; (g) Responding to judicial or administrative requirements and compliance with judicial or legal mandates; (j) Controlling access to facilities, establishing security measures, including video surveillance and closed-circuit television recording and mandatory biosecurity measures, to protect the safety and security of people and property, compliance with schedules and work obligations, among others. This data is that which is: (i) collected directly at guard posts, security and service points, (ii) taken from documents provided by individuals to security personnel, and (iii) obtained from video recordings taken. I declare voluntarily, free of any error, coercion or fraud, that all statements and answers I have made in this document are correct, truthful, complete, and I authorize The Company to verify all the detailed information. Furthermore, I undertake to inform The Company of any change or update to information that may affect the statements and answers noted in this form, within a period not exceeding 30 days.
